sanskrit_verse: मनसश्चन्द्रमा जातश्चक्षुषश्च दिवाकरः । जघनादन्तरिक्षं च जगच्च सचराचरम् ॥१२८॥
transliteration: manasaś candramā jātaś cakṣuṣaś ca divākaraḥ | jaghanād antarikṣaṃ ca jagac ca sacarācaram ||
sph_interpretive_translation: From the mind was born the Moon; from the eye, the Sun. From the hip arose the atmosphere; from the universe emerged all beings, moving and unmoving.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from consciousness itself, not external imposition
Causation follows sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) rooted in pure awareness
Capacity-based responsibility arises from the level of consciousness expressed
Restoration logic aligns with cosmic order as emanating from unified source-consciousness
Consciousness alignment is foundational to ontological justice
executable_legal_axioms: IF a being's action stems from misaligned perception THEN initiate sensory realignment through guided cognition
IF societal disharmony arises THEN trace causal sequence back to disruption in consciousness field
IF imbalance detected in individual THEN restore capacity via integration with cosmic rhythm
IF conflict involves multiple parties THEN realign based on shared origin in universal consciousness
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that all disputes originate from a singular source-consciousness. The court must recognize the primacy of perceptual alignment over factual contention. Judgment is rendered by restoring parties to their inherent unity rather than assigning fault.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that causality flows from consciousness outward. As per anupūrvaśaḥ, misalignment manifests sequentially — first in perception, then cognition, then behavior. Thus, proportional responsibility lies in restoring awareness, not inflicting consequence. Nyaya ensures harmony with the undivided Self.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate pratyāhāra practices to withdraw senses from external distortions
Engage dharana-dhyāna to reconnect individual with solar-lunar consciousness rhythms
Facilitate samyama to dissolve karmic impressions causing perceptual dissonance
Establish śuddhi-vṛtti to realign mental field with cosmic intelligence
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: This law proceeds directly from the indivisible consciousness wherein all creation arises and resolves. Dharma is restored when perception aligns with its luminous origin. Reality bears no punishment. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
